name: io.github.parisbs/codex-subagent-mcp
title: Codex Subagent
description: Delegate coding tasks to the OpenAI Codex CLI, installed separately, with explicit model and effort.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_DELEGATIONS_PER_HOUR
environmentVariables.description: Delegation and follow-up processes per rolling hour: decimal integer 1 to 9007199254740991; unset means unrestricted. In memory per server; probes never count.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_BACKGROUND_JOBS
environmentVariables.description: Cap on running background jobs: decimal integer 1 to 8 (default 8). Blocking calls do not use this cap.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_USAGE_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in local usage log: on or off (default off). Records counts and settings, never prompts, code or paths; labels are caller text.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model used when a call names none. Unset: the only entry of a single-entry CODEX_SUBAGENT_ALLOWED_MODELS, otherwise a call without a model is refused with a suggestion.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_EFFORT
environmentVariables.description: Reasoning effort used when a call specifies none: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. Unset: the model's own default. Cannot exceed CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_EFFORT.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_ALLOWED_MODELS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of model slugs; anything else is refused. Unset: unrestricted. A single entry acts as the default model; an empty entry is a configuration error.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Sandbox used when a call specifies none: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access. Defaults to read-only and cannot exceed the ceiling.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on what a delegation may do: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access. Defaults to workspace-write; danger-full-access must be set explicitly.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_EFFORT
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. Unset: unrestricted. Higher efforts are lowered to a supported level, or refused if none fits.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MCP_SERVERS
environmentVariables.description: MCP servers from Codex's config a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated names.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_PLUGINS
environmentVariables.description: Installed Codex plugins a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated name@marketplace ids.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Whether a delegation keeps Codex's apps (connectors to external services): off (default) or on.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Codex executable name or path. Unset: codex, searched on PATH. On Windows it must run directly, such as codex.exe; a .cmd or .bat shim is refused.
